name: Re-Evaluating EVMBench
description: An expanded and contamination-free evaluation suite based on the original EVMbench, designed to assess AI agents' capabilities in smart contract security, including vulnerability detection and exploitation across multiple model configurations and real-world incidents.
reputation: An emerging smart-contract security benchmark that is notable for explicitly addressing contamination and for evaluating both vulnerability detection and exploit generation.
notes: Addresses limitations of original EVMbench by expanding configurations, controlling for data contamination, and evaluating on real-world incidents post model release.
